title: GFCC value_axis_choice signal payload v1
description: PlanetX narrative choice. The only writer of identity.value_axes. User-action origin only. Axis comes from the choice itself, not from the domain default. Job-match scores are not this signal.

axis.description: survival=钱多, freedom=事少, belonging=离家近. The option's imprint_axis, never the domain's primary axis.

imprint_name.description: Hand-written imprint name, such as 务实 / 尊严 / 审慎.

domain.description: Navigator six domains. Not the ask-chip list (学习域/生活域/社交域/健康域/创意域).

points.description: Points added to the named axis. GDD band is 1–5.
